deck: BROKERS, TPAS AND STOP-LOSS CARRIERS TEST LEVEL-FUNDED QUOTES, SURPLUS SPLITS, LASERS AND RENEWAL LOSS RATIOS AGAINST FULLY INSURED PREMIUMS
THEY BUILD PBM CONTRACT FORENSICS, CAA COMPLIANCE FILINGS, RBP AND DPC PLAN REDESIGNS, AND WORKERS' COMP E-MOD, AUDIT AND RECOVERY PLAYBOOKS
site_ui.lead: Twelve chapters of practitioner testimony map how employers escape double-digit fully insured renewals through level-funded and self-funded plans, interrogate stop-loss contracts, captives and PBM spread pricing, test reference-based pricing, direct contracting and broker commissions, and control CAA compliance, ERISA fiduciary exposure and workers' comp experience mods.
site_ui.summary: All 12 chapters synthesize 192 verbatim YouTube practitioner testimonies, with every claim carrying timestamped inline attribution to its source video. Benefits brokers, TPAs, stop-loss carriers and healthcare finance educators supply the street numbers, operator gates and pro-tips, and the chapters flag where they disagree on size cutoffs, surplus splits and underwriting thresholds.

flow: Run the loss-ratio math on the current renewal: a 120-employee group at a 60% loss ratio left roughly $560,000 of about $1.4 million in premium with the carrier
Gather the census with SIC and zip, every IHQ at 5 to 10 minutes per employee, and the quarterly wage and tax report, with the owner setting a hard Friday deadline
Price admin, specific and aggregate stop-loss and the claims fund, using Milliman Curve pharmacy underwriting and specific stop-loss of $10,000 to $20,000 with 125% aggregate
Get surplus-split and renewal language in writing, model a year-two laser to $200,000, and walk away from above-average claims, high ER use or a sale within one to two years
Confirm the 12-month contract and 12/18 or 12/24 runout, start enrollment 30 days before the effective date, and brief providers on the new ID card logo
Reopen admin and stop-loss fees every year, test regional networks or RBP at $9 versus $25 access fees and DPC diverting about $40 PMPM, and convert broker commission to a visible fee
